messages:
Hannah L: Noticed migration guide examples still reference model_name and a /v1/embeddings cURL in the quickstart. Customers hit errors.
Omar Z: Which file?
Hannah L: docs/quickstarts/embeddings.md and docs/migration.md, snippet block near top.
Kiara P: Paste the snippet?
Hannah L: ```python
resp = client.generate(model_name="redwood-small", prompt="hi")
print(resp.output_text)
```
Kiara P: Yep that will break in v2 (param renamed to `model`, response shape changed). I'll open a tiny PR to replace model_name with model, update curl to /v2/embeddings, and add a short "Quick migration checklist". PR 2066: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2066
docs-bot: lint: examples -> deprecated param 'model_name' detected.
Omar Z: Can we add a clearly labeled temporary compatibility shim for Python and TS so internal tutorials don't break immediately? Make it explicit "not for production" and include the deprecation timeline (runtime will accept model_name for 10 days).
Kiara P: Added both shims to PR and a short callout about 10-day grace period. Also added snippet-runner smoke tests.
preview-bot: deploy preview for PR 2066: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood/2066 (snippets tested).
Hannah L: Reviewed and left one nit about wording on the shim; otherwise LGTM.
Kiara P: Fixed nit and merged after CI. Posting an announcements note and redirect for the old quickstart URL.
Hannah L: Thanks
